<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to interpret the question: "Depending on the content of the document, which of the following is true?" So we choose correct statement that aligns with the document content.

Option A: President Biden's policy on immigration is to support legal immigrants because they came to the United States with dreams and can work with Americans to promote economic and social development in the United States.

Document mentions that Biden supports legal immigrants, says supports naturalized citizens, mentions building workforce, etc. That is true generally. But does the document explicitly say "support legal immigrants because they came to the United States with dreams and can work with Americans to promote economic and social development"? The document mentions that "the American story includes the story of courageous families who ventured here — be it centuries ago, or just this year — from every part of the world to seek new possibilities and help to forge our Nation. In every era, immigrant innovators... helped". Also mentions that Biden placed equity at the center, had increased naturalized appointees. This aligns somewhat, but not explicitly mention "they came with dreams..." but it's implied. So maybe A is okay.

Option B: President Biden said his policy on illegal immigration was more effective than his predecessor's, but could not be implemented because of Republican opposition. Document includes remarks that he launched many actions, but says Republicans rejected his comprehensive plan; he says can't be implemented because of congressional opposition. He claims new actions are not enough. Also he says it's not fully effective. So is B true? The document says his policy on illegal immigration was "more effective" than predecessor? Do we have a claim that it's more effective? He says "Our actions have helped" but does mention "but I can act..." He says "some of my actions do not fix the entire system; we need Congress." He claims he's building; but does he state "more effective than predecessor's"? He does not explicitly say that. So B maybe false.

Option C: President Biden said that the main reason why the United States refused to accept illegal immigrants from Mexico into the United States is that their entry method is illegal and easy to cause unrest, and the United States is friendly and welcoming to those who immigrate to the United States through legal channels. The document says Biden says border policy must be orderly, legal; they are forced to come via legal means; he expands paragraph about "why not only using fantasy." The statement is somewhat true: says his policy welcomes legal immigrants, but refuses illegal. He emphasize that legal is the only way. Might be somewhat correct. But phrase "refused to accept ... from Mexico because their entry method illegal and easy to cause unrest" seems a bit strong. He emphasises that illegal crossing causes problems. In Document, he says it's patchwork and does not work, and that they need order. But it does not say the US refuses due to "illegal entry method is illegal and easy to cause unrest." He says it can help. It might be partially correct, but not fully. However option D?

Option D: The US government has taken many measures to protect and support legal immigrants. For example, the US Department of Justice has set up a webpage dedicated to solving their hate crimes. USAID hosted more than 20 "Emergency Hate and Crime Response and Support" meetings, and the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission issued data visualization tools to analyze their demographic information.

Check: Document says DOJ set up resources, including a webpage for hate crimes, including 24 languages. It also says Department of Justice and Department of Education issued letter. It says US Agency for International Development hosted more than 20 “Urgent Hate Crimes Response/Support” meetings. And it says EEOC issued a data visualization tool to analyze AA and NHPI demographic info. So D matches content. It says "protect and support legal immigrants" - but these actions actually are about hate crimes against Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, Pacific Islanders, a demographic group but not necessarily only legal immigrants? However the text lumps them under AA and NHPI communities, which includes immigrants as well, but the statement "protect and support legal immigrants" is partly inaccurate; but the parts of DOJ page for hate crimes, USAID early meetings, EEOC tool are correct as per the fact sheet. So D is accurate regarding those actions though the framing might be slightly off but the question is about which statement is true. D uses exactly content: DOJ webpage, USAID meetings, EEOC tool. That is entirely true.

Option A also partial, but less precise. But D specifically lists the actions that are indeed present in the text. So D is correct answer.

Thus answer D.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|>\boxed{D}
